it.faq_q1: Come funziona la versione su chiavetta USB? È davvero senza installazione?
it.faq_a1: Sì! Scarichi una cartella .ZIP, la estrai su qualsiasi chiavetta USB o hard disk esterno e avvii l'eseguibile 'FatturaFacile.exe'. Il programma non scrive nel registro di sistema di Windows e conserva il database SQLite e le fatture generate nella stessa chiavetta. Puoi collegarla a qualsiasi PC con Windows 10 o Windows 11 e continuare a lavorare.
it.faq_q2: Cosa succede se perdo la chiavetta o il computer si rompe?
it.faq_a2: Poiché i dati risiedono solo localmente per garantire la massima privacy, è fondamentale fare backup. Fattura Facile include un pulsante automatico 'Copia di sicurezza': con un click puoi esportare l'intero database e i documenti in uno zip cifrato da salvare su Google Drive, OneDrive, NAS o inviarti via email.
it.faq_q3: Come gestite la Fatturazione Elettronica italiana e la QR-Bill svizzera?
it.faq_a3: Per il mercato italiano, il software genera i file conformi XML FatturaPA (standard AdE) che puoi firmare ed esportare, oppure trasmettere via SDI. Per il mercato svizzero, supportiamo la generazione ufficiale delle sezioni pagamento con codice QR Svizzero (QR-Fattura) conforme alle direttive SIX Interbank Clearing.
it.faq_q4: Come posso richiedere una personalizzazione per la mia attività?
it.faq_a4: Basta inviare una mail a info@fatturafacile.eu descrivendo cosa vorresti (ad esempio un campo specifico, un modello di stampa personalizzato, ecc.). Se è utile al settore, lo programmiamo gratuitamente e lo rilasciamo nella nuova versione aperta a tutti.

it.foot_geo_ch: Svizzera 🇨🇭: Compatibile con QR-Fattura (standard SIX), IVA svizzera (standard, ridotta, speciale).
it.mod_callout_desc: In Fattura Facile la privacy non è una casella da spuntare, ma la premessa ingegneristica dell'intero software.
it.mod_sec1_text: Quando utilizzi la versione Desktop scaricabile da chiavetta USB:
it.mod_sec1_b1: Zero trasmissione dati: I dati di fatturazione, anagrafiche clienti, importi e coordinate bancarie rimangono esclusivamente salvati nel file SQLite sul tuo disco rigido o chiavetta USB.
it.mod_sec1_b2: Nessun server intermedio: Non inviamo telemetria, non raccogliamo le tue fatture e non effettuiamo profiling.
it.mod_sec1_b3: Ruolo privacy: L'utilizzatore è il Titolare autonomo del trattamento dei dati dei propri clienti. Non sussiste alcun trasferimento transfrontaliero né necessità di nomina a Responsabile del Trattamento (DPA) nei confronti dello sviluppatore per la versione locale.
it.mod_sec2_title: 2. Versione Cloud Self-Hosted (Hosting a carico dell'utente)
it.mod_sec2_text: Anche scegliendo la variante multi-utente in rete:
it.mod_sec2_b1: Infrastruttura proprietaria del cliente: Il software viene installato sul tuo server, VPS o NAS. Noi non abbiamo accesso ai tuoi archivi.
it.mod_sec2_b2: Conformità totale: Tutti gli obblighi GDPR e nLPD restano interamente sotto la tua gestione diretta, azzerando qualsiasi rischio di data breach su server terzi.
it.mod_sec2_b3: Contatti diretti: Per qualsiasi quesito tecnico o proposta di modulo: info@fatturafacile.eu.
it.mod_sec3_text: Ai sensi degli articoli 15-22 del Regolamento UE 2016/679 (GDPR) e degli artt. 25-29 della Nuova Legge Federale sulla Protezione dei Dati svizzera (nLPD), gli interessati possono richiedere in qualsiasi momento l'accesso, la rettifica, la portabilità in formato aperto o la cancellazione integrale dei propri dati. Nella versione Desktop, hai già il pieno possesso fisico e matematico del file .db.

en.page_title: Fattura Facile | Simple Invoicing for Tradespeople & SMBs
en.page_description: Free and offline invoicing software with SQLite or self-hosted Cloud. Compliant with Italian FatturaPA SDI and Swiss QR-Bill SIX.
en.hero_badge_privacy: Privacy Compliant: EU GDPR & Swiss FADP
en.hero_subtitle: Stop struggling with bloated and slow ERP software. Issue invoices in 30 seconds straight from your PC or USB thumb drive with local SQLite, 100% free with no monthly subscriptions, or host your own multi-user private cloud.
en.why_heading: Not a 500-button monster ERP, but your lightweight everyday companion
en.why_sub: Electricians, plumbers, installers, landscapers and solo freelancers issue an average of 10-20 invoices a month. They don't need supply chain overhead, they just need to get paid promptly.
en.feat1_title: Estimate in 1 minute, Invoice in 1 click
en.feat1_desc: Draft quotes right on the job. Once the client approves, convert it into an official invoice in a single click with sequential numbering.
en.feat2_desc: Built-in support for Italian FatturaPA electronic XML (SDI via PEC or recipient code) as well as the Swiss QR-Bill standard with valid QR payment codes and VAT calculations.
en.feat3_desc: Create encrypted ZIP snapshots onto a secondary flash drive, local network NAS, or synced folder. Never lose an invoice even if you replace your computer.
en.versions_sub: No SaaS subscription fees to pay us. Work in total autonomy: offline on your desk or self-hosted on your private infrastructure.
en.box_desktop_sub: Engineered in native C#/.NET WPF with an embedded zero-configuration SQLite database.
en.box_desktop_f1: Zero installation: portable folder on any USB drive or external SSD.
en.box_desktop_f2: Total data privacy: zero financial data leaves your PC (Privacy by Design).
en.box_desktop_f3: Works anywhere: on job sites, in vans or workshops without Wi-Fi.
en.box_desktop_f4: Instant speed: sub-second boot times and immediate record saving.
en.box_desktop_lim: Single concurrent operator per file (local SQLite file lock constraint).
en.box_cloud_sub: Host it on your VPS, company server or home NAS (Docker / SQL Server or PostgreSQL).
en.box_cloud_f1: Concurrent multi-user access: team members and accountants connected together.
en.box_cloud_f2: Zero license or tenant fees: no SaaS subscription fees paid to us.
en.box_cloud_f3: Legal sovereignty: since you control the infrastructure, there are no third-party processor liabilities.
en.box_cloud_f4: 1-Click Migration: easily import your local SQLite file directly to the cloud instance.
en.custom_title: Need a specific feature or custom module?
en.custom_desc: Email us at info@fatturafacile.eu with your questions or workflow requirements. **We will build the custom feature or module completely FREE of charge** and include it in upcoming open releases so everyone in the community benefits.
en.custom_step1: Explain your workflow and what feature you need.
en.custom_step2: We develop the code free of charge in the .NET/WPF project.
en.custom_step3: The new release is published on GitHub and fatturafacile.eu for all.
en.custom_hint: Direct answers from our core development team.
en.faq_q1: How does the USB drive version work? Is it really portable without installing?
en.faq_a1: Yes! Simply download the .ZIP folder, extract it to any USB stick or portable SSD, and double-click 'FatturaFacile.exe'. The software does not modify Windows system registries and stores all documents in the local SQLite database on the drive itself. Plug it into any Windows 10 or 11 computer and resume working.
en.faq_q2: What happens if I lose the flash drive or my PC breaks down?
en.faq_a2: Because your data remains strictly local for privacy, regular backups are essential. Fattura Facile includes a single-click 'Create Backup' feature that packages your data into an encrypted ZIP file you can copy to OneDrive, Google Drive, an office NAS, or email to yourself.
en.faq_q3: How do you handle Italian Electronic Invoicing and Swiss QR-Bills?
en.faq_a3: For Italy, the app generates certified FatturaPA XML files for the Revenue Agency (SDI) with digital signature support and transmission options. For Switzerland, it formats official Swiss QR-Bills compliant with SIX Interbank Clearing specifications.
en.faq_q4: How can I request custom features for my specific trade?
en.faq_a4: Just email info@fatturafacile.eu with your ideas (e.g. customized fields, specific print templates, etc.). If it benefits users, we develop it free of charge and roll it into the next official open release.
en.dl_title: Start invoicing the easy way today
en.dl_sub: Download the free portable Windows package. No credit card required, no account setup needed.
en.foot_desc: The lightweight invoicing system created specifically for Italian and Swiss tradespeople and micro-businesses. Built with local SQLite architecture and self-hosted cloud option.
en.foot_geo_it: Italy 🇮🇹: Compatible with FatturaPA XML, payment tracking, and flat-rate/standard tax schemes.
en.foot_geo_ch: Switzerland 🇨🇭: Compatible with QR-Bill (SIX standard), Swiss VAT (standard, reduced, special rates).
en.mod_callout_desc: At Fattura Facile, privacy isn't a legal afterthought; it's the architectural foundation of our software.
en.mod_sec1_text: When utilizing the USB portable Desktop version:
en.mod_sec1_b1: Zero Data Transmission: Billing records, customer databases, tax IDs, and bank account numbers are stored exclusively inside the local SQLite file on your device.
en.mod_sec1_b2: No Intermediary Servers: We do not collect telemetry, track usage, or harvest invoice information.
en.mod_sec1_b3: Privacy Governance: The business user acts as the sole Data Controller. No cross-border data transfer occurs and no Data Processing Agreement (DPA) with us is necessary for local usage.
en.mod_sec2_title: 2. Self-Hosted Cloud Version (Hosting managed by client)
en.mod_sec2_text: Even when running the networked edition:
en.mod_sec2_b1: Client's Own Infrastructure: The system is deployed on your private servers or VPS. We have zero access to your database.
en.mod_sec2_b2: Direct Compliance: All GDPR and nLPA compliance aspects remain entirely within your internal control, avoiding third-party data breaches.
en.mod_sec2_b3: Direct contact: For questions or module requests: info@fatturafacile.eu.
en.mod_sec3_text: Under Articles 15-22 of EU GDPR and Articles 25-29 of the Swiss nLPA, individuals retain full rights of access, rectification, portability, and deletion. In the Desktop edition, you already possess full direct ownership of your raw database.

de.faq_q1: Wie funktioniert die USB-Stick-Version? Funktioniert sie wirklich ohne Installation?
de.faq_a1: Ja! Laden Sie einfach den .ZIP-Ordner herunter, entpacken Sie ihn auf einen beliebigen USB-Stick oder eine externe Festplatte und starten Sie die Anwendung 'FatturaFacile.exe'. Das Programm verändert die Windows-Registry nicht und speichert die SQLite-Datenbank sowie alle Dokumente auf dem Stick. An jedem PC mit Windows 10 oder 11 sofort einsatzbereit.
de.faq_q2: Was passiert, wenn der USB-Stick verloren geht oder der PC defekt ist?
de.faq_a2: Da alle Daten aus Datenschutzgründen nur lokal gespeichert sind, sind Backups essenziell. Fattura Facile verfügt über eine 1-Klick-Sicherungsfunktion: Exportieren Sie Datenbank und Dokumente als verschlüsseltes ZIP auf OneDrive, Google Drive, ein NAS oder per E-Mail.
de.faq_q3: Wie unterstützen Sie die italienische elektronische Rechnung und die Schweizer QR-Rechnung?
de.faq_a3: Für Italien erstellt die Software gesetzeskonforme FatturaPA-XML-Dateien für das SDI. Für die Schweiz generiert sie offizielle Schweizer QR-Rechnungen nach den Richtlinien von SIX Interbank Clearing inklusive korrekter Schweizer MwSt.
de.faq_q4: Wie kann ich Funktionsanpassungen für meinen Betrieb anfragen?
de.faq_a4: Senden Sie eine E-Mail an info@fatturafacile.eu mit Ihren Vorstellungen (z. B. spezielle Felder oder Druckvorlagen). Wenn es der Branche hilft, programmieren wir es kostenlos und veröffentlichen es in der nächsten Version.

de.foot_desc: Die Rechnungssoftware, speziell entwickelt für Handwerker und Kleinunternehmen in Italien und der Schweiz. Mit lokaler SQLite-Architektur und Self-Hosted-Cloud-Option.
de.foot_geo_it: Italien 🇮🇹: Kompatibel mit FatturaPA XML, Zahlungsverfolgung und Pauschal-/Standardbesteuerung.
de.foot_geo_ch: Schweiz 🇨🇭: Kompatibel mit QR-Rechnung (SIX-Standard), Schweizer MwSt. (Normalsatz, reduzierter Satz, Sondersatz).
de.mod_callout_desc: Bei Fattura Facile ist Datenschutz kein nachträgliches Häkchen, sondern das technische Fundament der gesamten Software.
de.mod_sec1_text: Bei Nutzung der portablen Desktop-Version auf dem USB-Stick:
de.mod_sec1_b1: Keine Datenübertragung: Rechnungsdaten, Kundendatenbanken, Beträge und Bankverbindungen verbleiben ausschließlich in der SQLite-Datei auf Ihrem Gerät.
de.mod_sec1_b2: Keine Zwischenserver: Wir erfassen keine Telemetrie, sammeln keine Rechnungen und führen kein Profiling durch.
de.mod_sec1_b3: Datenschutz-Rolle: Der Anwender ist alleiniger Verantwortlicher für die Daten seiner Kunden. Es findet kein grenzüberschreitender Datentransfer statt und kein Auftragsverarbeitungsvertrag (AVV/DPA) ist erforderlich.
de.mod_sec2_text: Auch beim Einsatz der vernetzten Mehrbenutzer-Variante:
de.mod_sec2_b1: Eigene Infrastruktur des Kunden: Die Software läuft auf Ihrem eigenen Server oder VPS. Wir haben keinerlei Zugriff auf Ihre Daten.
de.mod_sec2_b2: Vollständige Eigenkontrolle: Alle Pflichten nach DSGVO und nDSG verbleiben direkt bei Ihnen, wodurch Datenpannen bei Drittanbietern ausgeschlossen sind.
de.mod_sec2_b3: Direkter Kontakt: Für technische Fragen oder Modulvorschläge: info@fatturafacile.eu.
de.mod_sec3_text: Gemäß Art. 15–22 EU-DSGVO und Art. 25–29 des Schweizer nDSG haben Betroffene das Recht auf Auskunft, Berichtigung, Datenübertragbarkeit und Löschung. In der Desktop-Version besitzen Sie bereits die uneingeschränkte physische und digitale Kontrolle über Ihre .db-Datei.
